items: video doorbell with indoor monitor (sold as one system)
why: Both chats answered with doorbell-plus-monitor systems already sold and carded as one product (the eufy E340 + Smart Display E10 bundle and the SwitchBot Video Doorbell with Indoor Monitor), plus all-in-one wired intercom kits. Which doorbell pairs with which display, and wired versus wireless, does matter, but the shopper buys one packaged system, so a page comparing models and recommending one fits better than an assembled kit.
